leftEvidence.title: Jesus rebukes the demon and the boy is cured

points.label: Father’s description
points.left: The father describes seizures and repeated danger.
points.right: The father describes an only child seized, crying, convulsing, and bruised.

points.label: Agent terms
points.left: The narrator calls the expelled agent a demon.
points.right: The narrator calls it a demon and then an unclean spirit.

points.label: Return
points.left: The boy is cured from that hour.
points.right: Jesus returns the boy to his father.

payload.posture: Hold both Scripture sources together while keeping each speaker, participant, place, sequence, and claim visible.

rightEvidence.title: The demon throws the boy down and Jesus rebukes the spirit

payload.tension: The witnesses share failed disciples and Jesus’ rebuke but select different details of danger and restoration.
payload.title: The afflicted boy in Matthew and Luke
